appLanding.titleImageHint: Required for image titles. Upload a PNG with transparency; it keeps its transparent background.
appLanding.descriptionHint: Optional, up to 300 characters. Blank descriptions inherit from the global rule.
appLanding.previewHint: The preview resolves inheritance: this rule → global rule → built-in app default.
appLanding.deleteCopy: This removes “{name}” from app landing selection. Its stored media files are retained.
appLanding.emptyCopy: Create the global rule first. Until then, the app shows its built-in landing screen.
appLanding.loadError: App landing rules could not be loaded.
appLanding.saveError: The landing rule could not be saved.
appLanding.deleteError: The landing rule could not be deleted.
appLanding.backgroundInvalid: Upload a background image or enter a valid HTTPS video URL.
appLanding.posterInvalid: The video poster must finish uploading, or remove it.
appLanding.titleImageRequired: Upload a title image, or switch the title type back to text.
appLanding.countryInvalid: Enter a valid two-letter country code.
appLanding.geoInvalid: Enter a city, valid coordinates and a radius between 1 and 250 miles.
appLanding.priorityInvalid: Priority must be a whole number from 0 to 10,000.
appLanding.globalExists: A global rule already exists. Edit that rule instead.
appLanding.globalProtected: The global rule is permanent. Edit its content instead of deleting it or changing its scope.

appearance.title: Appearance & placements
appearance.subtitle: One rule set for the iOS landing screen, the Discover hero carousel and the light/dark palette. A rule may apply globally, per App Store storefront or by the member's current location; every field a rule leaves blank inherits down the chain to the compiled app default.
appearance.precedence: Geo match → store country → global rule → compiled app default
appearance.loadError: Appearance rules could not be loaded.
appearance.emptyCopy: Create the global rule first. Until then the app renders its compiled defaults.
appearance.deleteCopy: This removes “{name}” from resolution. Its uploaded media files are retained.

errors.conflict: Someone else changed this rule in the meantime. The list was reloaded — open the rule again and redo your change.
errors.notFound: This rule no longer exists. The list was reloaded.
errors.globalProtected: The global rule is permanent: edit its content instead of deleting it or changing its scope.
errors.writeRequired: Your role can view appearance rules but not change them.
errors.timeout: Core did not answer in time. The write may or may not have landed — the list was reloaded; check before retrying.
errors.uncertainNotLanded: Core's answer was lost. The list was reloaded and does not contain this change — you may redo it.
errors.uncertainConflict: Another administrator's write took the next revision while yours was in flight (uncertain answer), so your write did not land and your draft was closed. The authoritative rule is shown — reopen it to make the change deliberately on top of theirs.
errors.uncertainSuperseded: The rule moved on by more than one revision while your write was uncertain, so it is ambiguous whether it landed before being overwritten. Your draft was closed and is never retried; the authoritative rule is shown — reopen it to edit deliberately.
errors.uncertainReloadFailed: Core's answer was lost and the list could not be reloaded. Reload before doing anything else; a repeated save could create a duplicate rule.
errors.save: The rule could not be saved.
errors.delete: The rule could not be deleted.

toast.recovered: Appearance rule saved (confirmed from the reloaded list).
toast.deletedRecovered: Appearance rule deleted (confirmed from the reloaded list).

validation.name: Enter an admin label (1–120 characters).
validation.storefront: Choose the App Store storefront country.
validation.geo: Enter a place label, valid coordinates and a radius between 1 and 500 km.
validation.countryCode: The optional country must be a valid two-letter code.
validation.priority: Priority must be a whole number from 0 to 10,000.
validation.window: The end of the window must be after its start.
validation.background: Upload a background image or video, or leave the background blank to inherit.
validation.poster: The video poster must finish uploading, or remove it.
validation.titleImage: The title image must be an absolute https address that has finished uploading.
validation.titleImageRequired: An image title needs a title image. Upload one, or switch the title type to text, none or inherited.
validation.qrIcon: The QR icon must be an uploaded PNG with an absolute HTTPS address, or blank for the built-in glyph.
validation.qrGeometry: QR icon padding must leave an icon box at least 8 pt wide and high.
validation.landingControl: A landing text contains a control or invalid character (line break, tab, unpaired surrogate or similar). Remove it — Core refuses such values instead of repairing them.
validation.landingValue: A landing value is outside its allowed range or vocabulary. Colours must be uppercase #RRGGBB and opacity values must have two decimals.
validation.landingPair: Background type and media, plus each overlay colour and opacity, must be set or inherited together.
validation.footerTags: Each footer language needs exactly one '<terms>'…'</terms>' pair and one '<privacy>'…'</privacy>' pair.
validation.heroItem: Every hero item needs an uploaded image or an HTTPS video URL; destination links must use HTTPS.
validation.heroTypography: Hero font sizes must be 10–120 px and colours #rrggbb values; leave a field empty for the default.
validation.palette: Palette colours must be #RRGGBB values; tick “inherit” for a role you do not want to set.

editor.targetingCopy: Where and when the rule applies. A geo rule always beats a store-country rule, which beats the global rule.
editor.name: Admin label

scopeOption.geo: Geo (current location: city or map point + radius)

scopeHint.global: The single base rule every override inherits from.
scopeHint.storefront: Matched by the device's App Store storefront, not by where the member is.
scopeHint.geo: Matched by the member's current location (GPS if the app already has permission, otherwise IP).

editor.globalScopeLocked: The global rule keeps its scope; edit its content.
editor.storefrontHint: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3, the App Store storefront of the device.
editor.placeLabelHint: Shown in the rule list; a city search fills it in.
editor.countryCodeHint: Metadata only — it never takes part in matching.
editor.radiusHint: 1–500 km. A city search suggests the radius that covers the city's viewport.
editor.priorityHint: Higher wins among overlapping rules of the same scope. Equal-priority geo rules use the nearest centre, then the smaller radius, then the newest.
editor.windowHint: Optional event window in your local time; stored as UTC. Start is inclusive, end is exclusive.
editor.windowAlways: No window: the rule applies whenever it is active.
editor.windowInvalid: Enter a valid date and time for the window.
editor.landingCopyGlobal: The base landing content. Blank fields fall back to the compiled app default.
editor.landingCopyOverride: Fill only what differs; blank fields inherit from the global rule, then from the compiled default.
editor.backgroundInheritHint: Optional. Leave it empty to inherit the background.
editor.posterHint: Optional. Inherits on its own and is shown only while the effective background is a video.
editor.titleTextHint: Optional. Blank titles inherit; the compiled default is “friending.”.
editor.titleImageHint: Transparent PNG. Required while the title type is Image.
editor.titleImageInheritHint: Optional transparent PNG. Used only where the inherited title type is an image.
editor.descriptionHint: Optional, up to 300 characters. Blank descriptions inherit.
editor.landingPreviewHint: Resolved as this rule → global rule → compiled default, in the console's language. The button shows the resolved light accent.
editor.heroCopy: Inherit the chain's carousel or replace it with this rule's own items. An empty override falls through to the global hero.
editor.paletteCopyGlobal: The brand palette. Every role you leave on “inherit” uses the compiled default.
editor.paletteCopyOverride: Override single roles per mode; everything else inherits from the global rule, then the compiled default.

landingComposer.invalidPreviewValue: Invalid draft value. The preview is using the inherited or compiled-default value.

background.title: Background
background.copy: Set the image or video, optional poster and the colour overlay painted above the media.
background.pendingUpload: Upload a {type} to apply this type. Until the upload finishes, both background fields inherit.

title.title: Title
title.copy: Show styled text, a centred PNG logo, or no title. Hidden text and image values remain available until you clear them.
title.logoHint: PNG only, at most 4 MB; transparency is preserved.
title.logoTypeHint: The logo is shown only when the title type is Image.

subtitle.title: Subtitle
subtitle.copy: Localized supporting copy with its own typography, optional colour backdrop and position above the sign-in buttons.
subtitle.visibilityHelp: Hiding removes both the subtitle and its backdrop from the landing screen without deleting either localized text.
subtitle.textGapHelp: The text title and visible subtitle form one block anchored above the topmost visible sign-in button. This gap does not move an image logo.

buttons.title: Buttons
buttons.copy: Phone and e-mail have independent labels and colours. Apple keeps one of Apple's mandated styles; all three share the app-wide primary-button corner radius.
buttons.radiusHelp: Applies to the apps' shared primary action buttons everywhere, including landing, signup, account and AreYouIn—not to cards, chips or icon buttons.

footer.title: Footer
footer.copy: The footer is pinned to the bottom edge. Each sentence must contain exactly one '<terms>'…'</terms>' and one '<privacy>'…'</privacy>' pair.
footer.minHeightHelp: The background reaches the physical bottom edge while the text stays above the safe area. Intrinsic content may make the footer taller.

qr.title: QR reader
qr.copy: Configure the circular scanner button pinned to the top-right safe area, including its diameter and uploaded PNG icon.
qr.iconUploadHint: PNG only, at most 4 MB. Blank uses the built-in QR glyph.
qr.paddingHelp: The inset applies on every side. The remaining icon box must be at least 8 × 8 pt.
qr.geometryError: This diameter and padding leave less than an 8 × 8 pt icon box.
qr.geometryClampWarning: The inherited effective pair would be unsafe, so Core publishes {padding} pt padding and the preview shows that clamp.
qr.renderHelp: Tinted uses the icon tint colour. Original colours affect uploaded PNGs only; the built-in glyph is always tinted.

preview.parentLoading: Loading the parent-only effective composition from Core…
preview.targetNeeded: Choose a valid storefront or geo centre to resolve this rule's parent chain.
preview.parentError: Core's parent-only preview could not be decoded. The phone remains a local fallback and is not proof of the inherited state.
preview.approximate: Approximate preview — parent read unavailable. Inherited values may change when Core responds.

compare.savedOnly: This check deliberately compares the saved rule; unsaved draft changes stay local.
compare.saveFirst: Save the new rule before comparing it with Core.
compare.parentUnavailable: Comparison is available after the parent read succeeds.
compare.error: Core's saved-state preview could not be decoded.
compare.same: The local saved-state merge matches Core for this language.

hero.inheritNoneGlobal: the global rule has no chain above it — inherit means no carousel
hero.replaceEmpty: No items yet — this empty override falls through to the global hero.
hero.replaceEmptyGlobal: No items yet — the global carousel stays hidden until an item is added.
hero.campaignImageHint: The uploaded image is optimized and stored on the Friending image CDN.
hero.cropTopBottom: This image is taller than the Discover slot and will be cropped at the top and bottom.
hero.cropLeftRight: This image is wider than the Discover slot and will be cropped on the left and right.
hero.dimensionsUnavailable: Image dimensions could not be read from this remote URL; use the recommended size and ratio above.
hero.videoUrlHint: Use an HTTPS video URL served by an approved CDN.
hero.destinationUrlHint: Optional HTTPS link opened when the card is selected.
hero.linkTitleHint: Shown as the tappable link under the copy. Empty keeps the app's default label.
hero.typographyHint: Per-platform font size, weight and colour for the title and subtitle. Empty keeps the app's default styling.
hero.title: Title
hero.subtitle: Subtitle

map.searchHint: Geocoded by Core; pick a result to fill the centre, radius, label and country.
map.searchError: The city search failed. Check your connection and try again.
map.searchForbidden: Your role can view rules but not run a city search.
map.mapHint: Drag the marker or click the map to move the centre. The circle shows the radius.
map.mapReadOnlyHint: The map shows the selected city's centre and research radius. Choose the city with search and edit the radius in the form.
map.unavailable: No Google Maps browser key is built into this console. Set the centre with the latitude, longitude and radius fields or a city search.
map.failed: The map could not be loaded. The latitude, longitude and radius fields still work.
map.authRequired: Sign in to the admin console to use the map picker.

palette.hint: Colours are #RRGGBB. The previews paint the resolved palette for each mode with the V3 Discover elements.

testPreview.title: Preview for a test location
testPreview.copy: Ask Core's resolver what the app would receive for a storefront, coordinates or IP address. Nothing here is computed in the browser.
testPreview.ipHint: Optional. Without coordinates Core resolves the location from this IP; without both, from your own request.
testPreview.coordinatesInvalid: Enter both a valid latitude and longitude, or neither.
testPreview.previewError: The preview could not be resolved.
testPreview.heroEmpty: No hero items for this location.

modeSwitcher.title: Mode switcher
modeSwitcher.subtitle: The two mode cards the app shows in the “Choose a mode” drawer: their title, subtitle and icon, in English and Hungarian.
modeSwitcher.loadError: The mode cards could not be loaded.

cardsCopy.people: The people mode: browsing and meeting people nearby.
cardsCopy.dates: The AreYouIn mode: activities members host and join.

preview.note: The app draws the icon bare, with no rounded background, exactly as tall as the title and subtitle together.

icon.label: Icon
icon.hint: Transparent PNG, square, at most {max} px on a side. Leave it empty to let the app draw its own icon.

errors.signature: That file is not a valid PNG.
errors.dimensions: The icon must be square and at most 512 px on a side.
errors.upload: The icon could not be uploaded. Try again.

live.noChange: Nothing changed — the stored cards already match this copy.

live.converged: The earlier save did land. The cards below are the stored ones.

configuration.title: Configuration
configuration.subtitle: Only allow-listed, reversible product settings belong here. Infrastructure secrets remain server-managed.
configuration.peopleHeroEnabledCopy: When disabled, Discover receives an empty hero list while campaign records remain intact.
configuration.demoSystemEnabledCopy: Controls whether isolated demo profiles are visible to approved demo accounts. It never merges demo and regular users.
configuration.sessionIdleCopy: A signed-in Join browser remains authenticated for this many minutes after the member's last real interaction. Background realtime and polling do not extend it.
configuration.sessionIdleHint: Whole minutes from {minimum} to {maximum}. Active browsers renew their encrypted session automatically.
configuration.sessionIdleInvalid: Enter a whole session timeout within the allowed minute range.
configuration.appearanceModeCopy: Controls the entire iOS app. System follows the device setting live; Light and Dark force that appearance from launch.

system.title: Follow device
system.copy: Automatically follows the user's iOS Light or Dark appearance.

light.title: Force Light
light.copy: Always launches and remains in Light appearance.

dark.title: Force Dark
dark.copy: Always launches and remains in Dark appearance.

push.title: Enabled delivery providers
push.copy: Choose which registered provider channels Core may use for push delivery. The worker handles each enabled channel independently.
push.separate: This global policy does not register a member or prove delivery. User detail shows channel presence separately; provider credentials remain server-managed.
push.invalid: Core did not return an exact supported push-delivery setting. No value was assumed or submitted.
push.writeRequired: Your administrator role may read this setting but cannot change runtime configuration. The authoritative value was reloaded.
push.uncertain: The save outcome could not be proven from Core's response. The authoritative configuration was reloaded before another action was enabled.

fcm.title: FCM only
fcm.copy: Send only through usable FCM registrations.

onesignal.title: OneSignal only
onesignal.copy: Send only through usable OneSignal registrations.

both.title: Both providers
both.copy: Fan out independently to every usable FCM and OneSignal registration.

configuration.safetyCopy: Mailgun, MongoDB, signing secrets, socket hosts and Apple credentials are intentionally not editable here.
configuration.loadError: Runtime configuration could not be loaded.
configuration.saveError: Runtime configuration could not be saved.
configuration.profileLinkBaseCopy: The origin members' shareable profile links and QR codes are minted from. Only origins that released app builds recognise are offered — a link on an unknown host does not degrade the in-app QR screen, it removes it. Opening the app from a host also needs that domain in the signed build's associated domains; otherwise the link still works, but lands in the browser.
configuration.webBaseCopy: The origin the legal, marketing and giveaway links in the apps are built from — privacy policy, terms and similar. Free text, because these only ever open in a browser: a wrong value costs a broken link, not a broken screen. It must be an https origin with no path; each consumer appends its own.

sectionAvailability.title: Travel and AreYouIn
sectionAvailability.copy: Set each section once: a global answer plus deliberate App Store storefront overrides. The App Store supplies the storefront; member location is not used.
sectionAvailability.conflictReloaded: Revision {revision} is now current. Your unsaved section edits were preserved; review them, then save again.
sectionAvailability.writeRequired: Editor access is required to save section availability.
sectionAvailability.saveError: The save was not confirmed. Authoritative section settings were reloaded; review them before trying again.
sectionAvailability.visibilityOnly: This controls whether released clients may present a section and its entry point. It is not an authorization or endpoint-enforcement control.
sectionAvailability.vocabularyWarning: Stored storefronts outside Core's current vocabulary are still shown and must be replaced or removed before saving: {codes}.

travel.title: Travel
travel.copy: Controls the Travel section and its plane entry point for the resolved storefront.

dates.title: AreYouIn
dates.copy: Controls the AreYouIn section and its hamburger-drawer entry for the resolved storefront.

sectionAvailability.globalCopy: Used when no usable storefront is supplied or that storefront has no override.
sectionAvailability.overridesCopy: An override replaces the global answer for exactly one App Store storefront.
sectionAvailability.emptyOverrides: Every storefront currently uses the global answer.

errors.storefront: Choose a valid ISO three-letter App Store storefront for every override.
errors.duplicateStorefront: The same storefront cannot appear twice in one section control.
errors.vocabulary: Replace or remove every flagged storefront before saving section availability.
errors.revision: The shared settings revision is invalid. Reload before saving.
errors.refusedSetting: Core refused a section availability value. Reload and review both section controls.
errors.refusedStorefront: Core does not accept storefront {code}. Replace or remove that override.

teaser.title: Soft off — teaser modal
teaser.copy: When a section is switched off you can still show its entry point and explain why. This copy has its own revision and its own save; it is not part of the section-availability save above.
teaser.loadError: Teaser copy could not be loaded. Nothing on this card was changed.
teaser.allHidden: Both sections are fully hidden when off. Turn a Hidden switch off to author a teaser.
teaser.hiddenCopy: On is today's behaviour: a switched-off section disappears completely. Off keeps the entry point visible and opens the teaser modal instead.
teaser.hiddenActive: Fully hidden when off: no icon, no drawer row, no modal.
teaser.onlyWhenOff: This section is currently available, so no teaser is published. The copy is stored and takes effect as soon as the section is switched off for a storefront.
teaser.blankFallback: Leave a field blank to publish Friending's compiled copy for that language.
teaser.previewTitle: What members see in the modal
teaser.reasonHint: Required, 1–300 characters. It is recorded in the audit trail, never shown to members.

live.pending: The last teaser save has an unknown outcome. Retry sends the same command; it never starts a second one.
live.converged: The retained teaser save is confirmed applied.
live.noChange: Nothing changed: the stored teaser copy already matches this draft.
live.replayed: This teaser save had already been applied; the stored result was returned.
live.conflict: Someone else saved teaser copy first. Revision {revision} is now shown; review it and save again.
live.conflictAlreadyApplied: Revision {revision} already carries exactly this teaser copy, so nothing was written.
live.draftInvalid: A teaser title or description is too long, untrimmed or blank-but-spaced. Fix the flagged field.
live.reasonRequired: Enter an internal reason of 1–300 characters before saving teaser copy.
live.requestIdUnavailable: This browser cannot mint a request id, so the teaser save was not sent.
live.unknownError: Core returned an unusable teaser response. Nothing was changed here.

errors.readRequired: you do not have teaser read access
errors.editRequired: editor access is required to change teaser copy
errors.tooLarge: the request body was too large

errors.sectionsInvalid: the two sections were not accepted as sent
errors.hiddenInvalid: the Hidden switch was not accepted as a boolean
errors.titleInvalid: a title is too long, untrimmed or blank-but-spaced
errors.descriptionInvalid: a description is too long, untrimmed or blank-but-spaced

authPolicy.title: Authentication policy
authPolicy.copy: Choose the global sign-up and sign-in methods, then override deliberate App Store storefronts. The storefront is supplied by the App Store, never inferred from a member's location.
authPolicy.conflictReloaded: Revision {revision} is now current. Your unsaved edits were preserved; review them, then save again.
authPolicy.writeRequired: Editor access is required to save the authentication policy.
authPolicy.saveError: The save was not confirmed. Authoritative policy settings were reloaded; review them before trying again.
authPolicy.vocabularyWarning: Stored policy values outside the current Core vocabulary are still shown and must be replaced before saving: {codes}.
authPolicy.globalCopy: Used when the app supplies no known storefront or no storefront override exists. Phone and e-mail cannot both be disabled here.

phone.title: Phone sign-up and sign-in
phone.copy: Offers phone authentication where the resolved storefront policy permits it.

email.title: E-mail sign-up and sign-in
email.copy: Offers e-mail authentication where the resolved storefront policy permits it.

apple.title: Sign in with Apple
apple.copy: Always available and read-only. It does not make a phone-and-e-mail-off global default valid.

authPolicy.overridesCopy: Each ISO three-letter country replaces both global method values for that App Store storefront.
authPolicy.emptyOverrides: Every storefront currently uses the global method default.
authPolicy.dialCopy: Choose the exact countries shown in phone pickers. This one country control also derives the E.164 calling-code allow-list used by Core; the two setting families are saved together and cannot drift.
authPolicy.dialFormatHelp: Add an optional mask for a calling code derived from the selected countries. Each * is a digit placeholder; an empty input keeps the app's automatic formatting. A saved mask remains visible but inert when no selected country uses its code.
authPolicy.dialFormatAutomatic: No override — the app formats this code automatically.
authPolicy.dialFormatInvalid: Use 1–32 characters, include at least one *, and use only spaces or ( ) - . /. Do not include + or the country calling code.
authPolicy.unknownCallingCode: {code} is outside Core's current calling-code vocabulary.
authPolicy.noCountries: No country is allowed by this rule. The app presents no country picker entry for this scope.
authPolicy.emptyDialFormats: No selected country currently derives a calling code to format, and no inert mask is stored.
authPolicy.dialOverridesCopy: Optionally replace the global allowed-country rule for individual App Store storefronts. Calling codes are derived from the same countries.
authPolicy.emptyDialOverrides: Every storefront currently uses the global allowed-country rule.

errors.noMethod: Keep phone or e-mail enabled in the global default.
errors.storefront: Choose a valid ISO three-letter App Store storefront for every override.
errors.duplicateStorefront: The same storefront cannot appear twice in one override list.
errors.regions: Allowed-country rules may contain only valid, unique countries from Core's current vocabulary.
errors.vocabulary: Replace every flagged stored value before saving this policy.
errors.dialFormatCode: Every phone-format entry must use a valid, canonical calling code.
errors.duplicateDialFormat: Each calling code may have only one phone-number mask.
errors.dialFormatMask: A phone-number mask must use 1–32 characters, include at least one *, and contain only the permitted separators.
errors.dialFormats: Phone formats must be a list of exact code-and-mask pairs.
errors.revision: The authentication-policy revision is invalid. Reload before saving.

locationAccess.title: Location access
locationAccess.subtitle: Decides whether the app needs the device's location before the Nearby tab and before signup. The two switches are independent, both are off by default, and this panel saves on its own.
locationAccess.scope: Only iOS app versions that read this policy apply it. Older iOS versions, Android and the Join website ignore it, and Core does not enforce it.
locationAccess.reviewRisk: Requiring location at signup can get the app rejected by App Review (guideline 5.1.1(iv)). After review, never switch on a stricter policy that the reviewed version did not show. Approximate location while the app is in use is enough.
locationAccess.neverSaved: Never saved: the default applies and nothing is required.

required_for_nearby.title: Require location for the Nearby tab
required_for_nearby.copy: Without location access, the Nearby tab on People shows a location prompt instead of results. Chat, profiles, travel and a manually chosen city stay available.

required_for_signup.title: Require location at signup
required_for_signup.copy: Signup asks for location access and sets the starting city from the device instead of letting the member pick it. Members can change their city after signup.

locationAccess.readOnly: Your role can view this policy but cannot change it. Ask an owner or an admin.
locationAccess.unavailable: Core cannot read the location access policy right now. Nothing has been assumed about the current setting; try again shortly.
locationAccess.loadError: The location access policy could not be read. Nothing has been assumed about the current setting.
locationAccess.unchanged: Nothing to save: the stored policy already matches.
locationAccess.conflict: Someone else saved this policy while you were editing. The stored version is now revision {revision}.
locationAccess.conflictDraftKept: The switches still show your unsaved choices. Review them, then save again or discard them.
locationAccess.conflictReloadFailed: Someone else saved this policy while you were editing, and the new version could not be loaded. Your unsaved choices are still shown; reload before saving again.
locationAccess.notConfirmed: The save could not be confirmed because Core did not answer normally. Your choices are still shown; reload to check what is stored before saving again.
locationAccess.writeRequired: Your role can no longer change this policy. The stored values are shown.
locationAccess.invalid: Core refused this policy as invalid. Reload and try again.
locationAccess.unexpected: Core answered in an unexpected way. Reload to check what is stored before saving again.
locationAccess.confirmCopy: Compatible iOS apps will require location access for: {flags}. Members who do not allow it cannot use that part of the app.
locationAccess.confirmSignupRisk: Requiring location at signup can lead to App Store rejection; switch it on only for a version App Review has seen behaving this way.

welcomeMessage.title: Welcome message for new members
welcomeMessage.subtitle: Right after registering, every new member finds this message in their Support conversation in the app. This panel saves on its own.
welcomeMessage.defaultOn: On by default: unless it is switched off here, every new member gets this message in their Support conversation (Profile › Support) with an unread badge and a notification. Members who signed up in Hungarian get the Hungarian text, everyone else the English one. A change only affects later registrations; members who registered earlier are never messaged. Replies arrive in the Support inbox.
welcomeMessage.loadError: The welcome message could not be loaded. Nothing has been assumed about the current setting, and editing stays off until it can be read.

enabled.purpose: Master switch for collection checks and city research.
enabled.effect: Off stops automatic research for every city and source.
enabled.cost: No new research AI spend while off.

source_enabled.purpose: Enable automatic checks for this collection source.
source_enabled.effect: The master research switch, robots policy, stock and budget still apply.
source_enabled.cost: A disabled source starts no scheduled checks. Manual checks are separate commands.

auto_cities_enabled.purpose: Lets cities in automatic mode start at their member threshold.
auto_cities_enabled.effect: Cities set to always on do not depend on this switch.
auto_cities_enabled.cost: More active cities can increase research spend.

cadence_hours.effect: A city can inherit this interval or use its own. Each source has its own interval.
cadence_hours.cost: Shorter intervals can increase fetches and AI calls; unchanged pages avoid a new discovery call.

scope.purpose: Area in which members and upcoming events are counted.
scope.effect: Use city bounds or a radius around Core's resolved city centre.
scope.cost: A larger area may find more events and require more processing.

radius_km.purpose: Distance from the resolved city centre.
radius_km.effect: US and GB cities initially display miles; other cities display kilometres. Core stores kilometres.
radius_km.cost: Changing units alone has no cost and does not change the stored radius.

member_threshold.purpose: Members whose last known position is inside the research area.
member_threshold.effect: Automatic mode starts once this count is reached. Counts are refreshed by Core.
member_threshold.cost: A higher threshold can limit the number of cities spending research budget.

target_events.purpose: Desired stock of upcoming events in the area.
target_events.effect: Published events and events in review inside the window count toward the target. Runs only fill the missing stock.
target_events.cost: A met target causes a skipped run without discovery spend.

window_days.purpose: How far ahead to discover and count events.
window_days.effect: Past events and events beyond this window do not fill the stock.
window_days.cost: A longer window may require more candidate processing.

autopublish.purpose: Allow eligible official-source events to be published automatically.
autopublish.effect: Core still requires all safety checks, a new event, a non-sensitive category and a start at least 24 hours away. Other events wait for review.
autopublish.cost: Does not raise the AI budget; discovery and validation still cost money.

city.purpose: Resolved city associated with an area or a source.
city.effect: City identity and geometry come from Core. A source without a city uses global values.
city.cost: Selecting a city does not start a run by itself.

mode.purpose: Choose automatic, always on or off for this city.
mode.effect: Automatic uses the member threshold; always on bypasses it. The master switch, country availability and budget still apply.
mode.cost: Always on can enable spend before the member threshold is reached.

url.purpose: Public first page of an event collection.
url.effect: Core checks robots policy and fetches only safe public URLs; links are checked separately.
url.cost: An unchanged page avoids discovery AI; event-page processing can still cost money.

label.purpose: Internal name for this collection source.
label.effect: Appears in lists and run filters.
label.cost: Changing the label makes no AI call.

type.effect: Official sources can supply a new own-words summary. Aggregators supply facts only; Core can follow an organiser link.
type.cost: Official event-page extraction may cost more than facts-only processing.

max_events.purpose: Maximum stock of upcoming events associated with this source.
max_events.effect: Each check tops up only what is missing; this is not a fresh allowance on every check.
max_events.cost: A lower cap can reduce candidate processing.

archived.purpose: Retire a source while retaining its history.
archived.effect: An archived source is not scheduled for further checks.
archived.cost: Archiving prevents new scheduled source spend.

reason.effect: Stored with the command for other administrators; it is not member copy.
reason.cost: No AI call is made for the reason.

source.purpose: Narrow history to one collection source.
source.effect: Only runs associated with the selected source are listed.
source.cost: Reading history does not start research.

runKind.purpose: Narrow history by the kind of research.
runKind.effect: Collection-source runs are available in this release.
runKind.cost: Changing a filter makes no AI call.

budget.purpose: Shared monthly cap for event AI.
budget.effect: Research stops at its served share of the cap, including reservations, leaving capacity for other channels.
budget.cost: The estimate is unknown until Core has measured real runs.

estimate.purpose: Monthly research checks and cost based on measured runs.
estimate.effect: Null means not measured yet, not zero. The estimate is not a spending permission.
estimate.cost: Actual spend remains bounded by the shared budget.

moderation.accessUnconfirmed: Current access could not be confirmed. Refresh the case and try again; no decision was sent.
moderation.factsUnavailable: The event details could not be read at this case's content revision. Case history and a saved decision receipt can still be read or retried. New changes are blocked until you refresh and review matching case and event details.
moderation.reloadRequired: The decision was not confirmed against this case and content revision. Refresh the case and event details, review them again, and confirm a new decision. Your written reasons are retained.
moderation.pendingCopy: A decision is awaiting an authoritative receipt. Other case changes are blocked. Retry only the saved request with its original case revision, event revision and key; an expired or unreadable record must not be silently discarded.
moderation.boundary: This case has no member subject. Member warnings, restrictions, account suspensions, participant or photo removal are not offered. Dismissal does not republish pending content. A moderation cancellation withdraws the event; it does not claim the organizer canceled it. Restore is limited to nonterminal, undeleted, unexpired content.

messageModeration.title: Message publication review
messageModeration.boundary: Pending and rejected messages are visible only to their author. Read the immutable evidence through the audited control below. Approval makes the message visible to eligible thread members; rejection keeps it private. This decision does not approve or republish the event.
messageModeration.unavailable: This message cannot be decided now. It may have changed, been deleted or already been reviewed. Refresh the case; retained history and authorized evidence remain readable.
messageModeration.reviewRequired: Current permission to resolve this message-review case is required. Refresh the case and permissions before retrying.
messageModeration.reloadRequired: The case, message or claim no longer matches this confirmation. Refresh and review the current case before confirming a new decision. Your written reasons are retained.
messageModeration.pendingCopy: The exact decision is saved. Other changes to message-review cases are blocked until its receipt is confirmed. Retry the original request; do not submit a replacement.
messageModeration.successRetained: Core confirmed the decision, but the saved request could not be cleared. New changes remain blocked. Retry the same request to recover its receipt.
messageModeration.refusedRetained: Core refused this decision, but the saved request could not be cleared. Do not submit a replacement; resolve the saved-request problem first.
messageModeration.invalid: Check the decision, audit reason and both member-facing reasons before continuing.
messageModeration.uncertain: The decision may have succeeded, but its receipt is unconfirmed. The exact request is saved. Retry it with the same key; do not submit a replacement.
messageModeration.blocked: The saved decision could not be safely read or written. New changes are blocked. Check browser storage and the saved request before retrying.
messageModeration.expired: This saved decision is too old for a safe retry. Do not delete it or submit a replacement. Ask the operations lead to reconcile the case and audit history first.

end.copy: End this event and make its conversation read-only. Attendance history remains; no host review or check-in prompts are created.

soft_delete.label: Soft-delete event
soft_delete.copy: Hide the event while retaining its ledger, attendance and history. Invitations end and the conversation becomes read-only. This can be restored without changing a terminal or pending state.

restore.label: Undo soft deletion
restore.copy: Restore the retained record only. A withdrawn, canceled or ended event stays terminal; pending moderation stays pending. No live-location access is granted.

purge.label: Permanently purge event
purge.copy: Irreversibly remove the event after retention eligibility. Core requires superadmin permission, no open case and no legal/evidence hold. The external ledger and interests are also removed. This cannot be undone.

withdraw.label: Withdraw publication
withdraw.copy: Remove this recommendation from active discovery. Attendance history is retained, invitations end and the conversation becomes read-only. This is not an upstream cancellation claim.

cancel.label: Record organizer cancellation
cancel.copy: Use only after confirming that the organizer canceled the event. Attendance history is retained, invitations end and the conversation becomes read-only.

reverify.label: Confirm source again
reverify.copy: Record a new human check with four fresh confirmations. This starts no AI or network job, sends no notification and does not approve pending moderation.

official_update.label: Post official update
official_update.copy: Post and pin a system update in the event conversation. Members see a Friending update, not your operator identity. The event must still be active and its conversation writable.

pending.title: Saved operation awaiting confirmation
pending.copy: Do not create a second operation. Retry sends the identical saved request and expected revision, including after a page reload.
pending.blocked: The saved-operation store is unavailable or unreadable. Changes are blocked to avoid losing retry evidence. Restore browser storage access and reload; do not delete an unresolved saved operation.

feedback.publishingDisabled: Publication and content corrections are disabled by the release switch. Only the release lead should enable it after compatible Core and Webadmin releases. Cancellation, withdrawal and saved successful receipt retries remain available.
feedback.recoveryOnly: Current event details are unavailable. Only the saved operation can be retried; this can recover a receipt after a successful purge. No new event change is enabled.
feedback.successRetained: Core confirmed the operation, but its local retry record could not be cleared. Changes remain blocked. Restore browser storage access and retry the same operation to reconcile the receipt.
feedback.refusedRetained: Core refused the operation, but its local retry record could not be cleared. Restore browser storage access and retry the same operation; do not create a replacement yet.
feedback.access: Fresh permissions or Core time could not be confirmed for this operator. No new operation was sent; existing retry evidence remains saved. Reload after restoring access.
feedback.invalid: Check the facts, audit reason and required confirmations before continuing.
feedback.uncertain: The operation may have succeeded, but its receipt is unconfirmed. The exact request is saved. Retry the same operation; do not submit a replacement.
feedback.blocked: The operation could not safely proceed. Check the saved-operation panel and browser storage before retrying.
feedback.expired: This saved operation is too old for a safe retry. Do not delete it or submit a replacement. Ask the operations lead to reconcile the event and audit history first.
feedback.conflict: Core refused this stale or unavailable event state. Your draft is retained. Reload current details, review the differences, then prepare a new operation; the revision is never replaced silently.
feedback.duplicate: Core found the same occurrence: an identical source URL and local date, or the same normalized title, venue and local date. Review the existing event instead of publishing a duplicate. A genuinely different recurring date remains allowed.
feedback.refused: Core refused this operation. Review the facts, time bounds, source and ticket links, audit reason and current event state before preparing a corrected request.

form.manualOnly: Enter facts checked against the source. This form does not use AI or automatically verify the organizer or venue.
form.title: Title (3–120 characters)
form.attendeeVisible: Eligible members may see the attendee list
form.sensitiveHint: Sensitive events always show counts only. Individual attendance privacy still applies.
form.timeHint: Enter the local clock time, the venue's IANA timezone (for example Europe/Budapest), and its UTC offset at that time (for example +02:00). The offset distinguishes repeated times at daylight-saving transitions. The browser's timezone is never assumed.
form.allDay: All-day event (the explicit times still apply)
form.endHint: With no end, Core estimates 3 hours for concerts/theatre, 5 for club nights, 10 for festivals and 2 for other categories. The maximum duration is 14 days for festivals and 24 hours otherwise.
form.mapHint: Move the pin to the public venue. A manual pin is an administrator confirmation, not a Places verification. Moving it clears the confirmations below.
form.mapUnavailable: The optional map is unavailable. Enter the public venue's checked decimal coordinates above; do not substitute a private meeting point.
form.officialUrl: Official event URL (required for paid events)
form.linksHint: Use HTTPS domain links without credentials or custom ports. Ticket links must use the exact official or organizer hostname, or a Core-approved domain. Saving never fetches the URL.
form.imagePolicy: P1 uses category artwork only. Member flyers are never event images. This form does not upload images, generate AI art or assert image licensing.
form.confirmSource: I checked these facts against the source.
form.confirmPublicVenue: I confirmed this is a public venue and the pin/address are correct.
form.confirmTimezone: I confirmed the venue timezone, local times and UTC offsets.
form.confirmContentSafe: I checked the content for safety and suitability.

errors.startTime: Check the start date, explicit UTC offset and venue timezone. Nonexistent local times and mismatched offsets are refused.
errors.endTime: Check the end date, explicit UTC offset and venue timezone.
errors.confirmations: Complete all four confirmations after the last facts edit.
errors.facts: Check the required text, HTTPS links, decimal coordinates, country code, duration and admission details. Invalid or oversized facts cannot be submitted.
errors.reason: Enter an audit reason of at least 3 characters.
