refusals.dates-external-intake-contract-required: Core does not serve this AI-assisted event to a console that does not send the intake contract: the released console cannot show it. This console sends it; if you see this, the request reached Core without it - reload the page.

memberConfirmationValues.confirmed: Confirmed by the member as drafted
memberConfirmationValues.unchecked: The member did not look at the draft in time
memberConfirmationValues.unanswered: The member did not answer the reviewer's question

member.title: The member's side
member.copy: What the member who suggested this event chose and did, exactly as Core serves it to a reviewer. Their own words are shown as plain text.
member.unreadable: The member's part of this suggestion could not be read. It is not empty and it is not "no member": do not decide on what is missing here. Refresh to read it again.
member.partUnreadable: This part could not be read. It is unknown, not absent.
member.erased: The member's account was erased: there is nobody to name and nobody to ask.
member.named: To be named on the event as the member who suggested it.
member.anonymous: Asked not to be named: the event will not show who suggested it.
member.goingYes: Asked to go if the event is approved.
member.goingNo: Did not ask to be joined.
member.consentVersion: Accepted version {version} of the suggestion terms.
member.confirmation: The member's look at the draft
member.confirmationNone: The draft has not been put to the member.
member.strikesHint: A strike is a rejection as spam or fake. One that is under a second look is not counted until that look ends.
member.corrections: What the member changed in the draft
member.correctionsNone: The member changed nothing in the draft.
member.correctionsUnreadable: Changes that could not be read: {count}. They are unknown, not absent.
member.correctionsHint: A changed value is the member's own claim: the source quotes that vouched for the old value no longer apply to it.
member.secondLookNone: No second look was asked for.

ask.title: Ask the member
ask.copy: Send the draft back to the member, once per suggestion: choose the fields they should look at again and, if you wish, write them a note. The suggestion leaves your hold and comes back to the queue when the member answers, or when the time Core gives them runs out.

why.unreadable: The member's part of this suggestion could not be read whole, so the member is not asked from this page.
why.notAskable: Core does not offer asking the member here: they were already asked once, their account was erased, or an event has already been published from this suggestion.
why.switchOff: Members' suggestions are switched off (dates_external_suggestions_enabled), so the member cannot be asked.
why.holdFirst: Take the intake to ask the member.

ask.noteHint: The member reads this, in your words. At most {maximum} characters. No internal remarks here.
ask.reasonHint: Kept in the audit log only; never shown to the member.
ask.confirm: Send this draft back to the member? They are notified, and the suggestion leaves the review queue until they answer. This can be done once per suggestion.
ask.invalid: Choose at least one field and write an audit note. A note to the member may not be blank or longer than 500 characters.
ask.uncertain: It is not known whether the request reached Core. The intake was read again: if it is still in review, send the same request again; it cannot be applied twice.
ask.done: The draft is with the member. Their answer is due by {time}.

commandOutcome.unknown: The outcome is not known: no readable answer came back. Check whether the change is there before you repeat it; Refresh shows the current state.
commandOutcome.unknownAnswered: The outcome is not known ({error}). Check whether the change is there before you repeat it; Refresh shows the current state.

imageEditor.title: Crop, rotate and zoom
imageEditor.copy: Drag or use the arrow keys to reposition; pinch or use the zoom controls to magnify. Saving overwrites the member's picture everywhere and marks it approved.
imageEditor.squareCopy: Drag and pinch to frame the square thumbnail shown on the profile picture strip. Only the thumbnail changes; the picture itself and its moderation status stay untouched.
imageEditor.canvasLabel: Picture crop preview. Drag or use the arrow keys to reposition; pinch to zoom.
imageEditor.loadError: The picture could not be loaded for editing.
imageEditor.saveError: The picture could not be saved. Please try again.
imageEditor.saved: The picture was updated and approved.
imageEditor.squareSaved: The square thumbnail was saved. The moderation status is unchanged.

inviteConfiguration.title: Mobile invitations
inviteConfiguration.subtitle: Choose whether Friending or the member's iPhone sends invitation SMS messages, globally or by App Store storefront country.
inviteConfiguration.loadError: The mobile invitation configuration could not be loaded.

global.title: Global fallback
global.copy: Used when StoreKit has no storefront answer or no active country override matches. Disabling this hides mobile invitations everywhere.

server_sms.title: Friending sends the SMS
server_sms.copy: The selected phone number is sent to Core and the server sends the administrator-authored message.

device_sms.title: The iPhone sends the SMS
device_sms.copy: iOS opens the system Messages composer with the rendered text. The recipient is not submitted to the send endpoint.

templates.title: Localized SMS templates
templates.copy: The server renders the exact message for both delivery modes. English and Hungarian are required; more language codes can be added.

inviteConfiguration.languageInvalid: Enter a new two- or three-letter lowercase language code.

overrides.title: Storefront country overrides
overrides.copy: The country is StoreKit's App Store storefront code at the moment this screen opens. It is not written to the member profile.
overrides.emptyCopy: Every storefront currently uses the global fallback.
overrides.storefrontHint: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3, for example HUN, USA or GBR.
overrides.inherit: Leave a language blank to inherit its global template.

attribution.title: Invite results
attribution.copy: Read-only conversion statistics for mobile invitations. Counts only — no phone number or recipient identity is served or shown.
attribution.unavailable: Statistics are not available right now

validation.globalMessages: English and Hungarian templates are required, must stay under 600 characters and must contain '{user_url}'.
validation.tooManyOverrides: At most 250 storefront overrides can be saved.
validation.storefront: Every override needs a three-letter App Store storefront code, such as HUN.
validation.duplicateStorefront: Two overrides use the same App Store storefront code.
validation.overrideMode: Every country override needs a delivery method.
validation.overrideMessages: Every country-specific template must stay under 600 characters and contain '{user_url}'.

errors.conflict: Another administrator saved this configuration first. The current server copy has been loaded; apply your change again.
errors.save: The invitation configuration could not be saved. Reload before retrying to confirm whether the write landed.

signupPhotos.title: Signup photos
signupPhotos.subtitle: Configure the signup avatar screen, the photo grid limits, the tips box and the moderation notice.
signupPhotos.loadError: The signup photo configuration could not be loaded.
signupPhotos.unsaved: Unsaved changes. Saving writes the whole configuration at once.
signupPhotos.neverSaved: No configuration has been saved yet. Saving creates the first document.
signupPhotos.photosPanelCopy: How many pictures the signup photo grid requires and allows, and the moderation notice shown with it.
signupPhotos.minPhotosHint: Continue unlocks at this many completed uploads. Raising it above the maximum raises the maximum too.
signupPhotos.maxPhotosHint: The grid stops accepting uploads at this count. It can never exceed 6.
signupPhotos.moderationEnabledHint: When this is off the app hides the whole moderation row and the texts below are not required.
signupPhotos.moderationLinkUrlHint: An absolute https address. This is a policy page, so any host is accepted.
signupPhotos.avatarPanelCopy: The dedicated first-photo screen: its copy, the tips box heading, and the tip cards below the tile.
signupPhotos.tipsCopy: Each card needs a default picture and a caption in both languages. Up to {max} cards.
signupPhotos.tipsEmpty: No tip cards. The tips box stays hidden in the app while this list is empty.
signupPhotos.tipCapReached: The maximum of {max} tip cards has been reached. Remove one before adding another.
signupPhotos.tipImageFemaleHint: Shown to everyone unless a men's variant is uploaded. Required.
signupPhotos.tipImageMaleHint: Shown only to members whose own gender is man. Falls back to the default picture.

featureSwitchesPointer.title: Feature availability
featureSwitchesPointer.copy: The global Hey, Footprint-badge and photo-like switches live together in Configuration. Visitors is always available; badge limits and catalogue settings on this page keep their own document and revision.

limitRollout.legacy: Friending runs the legacy membership rules, so the daily limit on this page applies to every member, and a member-specific allowance below replaces it.
limitRollout.enforced: The membership plan now decides each member's daily Footprint limit, so the daily limit on this page no longer applies. A member-specific allowance below is a ceiling on the plan: it can lower the member's limit but never raise it.
limitRollout.deny: Enforcement is switched on without a saved membership plan, so nobody can send Footprints right now, whatever this page says. Save a plan on the Membership plans page.

featureSwitches.title: Feature switches
featureSwitches.lead: Global availability for Hey, Footprint badges and photo likes. Visitors is always available. Each change is revision-bound, receipted and audited by Core.
featureSwitches.familyRevisionNote: Hey, Footprints and Photo likes share this one family revision, so changing any switch refreshes all three. Runtime settings and Footprint badge settings use separate documents and revisions.
featureSwitches.launchPosture: Launch procedure: keep Hey on and explicitly turn Footprints off with an administrator reason before go-live. An absent stored value still defaults to enabled; a switch missing from the admin wire is shown as unavailable and cannot be changed.
featureSwitches.notServedDetail: This Core version does not publish this switch.
featureSwitches.notServedDescription: Release a Core version that serves this switch before trying to change it. The other feature switches remain available.

hey.title: Hey
hey.summary: The product-wide gate above the Pinger rollout setting.
hey.consequenceOff: Turning Hey off hides the Pinger button and the Heys collector tab, refuses new sends, and stops Hey bell rows and pushes. Existing Heys and matches remain; withdrawing a previous Hey stays possible.
hey.consequenceOn: Turning Hey on permits sending Heys again. The Pinger button still appears only when its separate rollout configuration is enabled; nothing is reconstructed for the off period.

footprints.title: Footprints
footprints.summary: The product-wide gate for the Footprint-badge family; visits and Visitors remain available, and photo likes use their own switch.
footprints.consequenceOff: Turning Footprints off hides Footprint-badge controls, feeds and counters and stops Footprint alerts and pushes. Visit recording and the Visitors list remain available. Photo likes follow their own switch.
footprints.consequenceOn: Turning Footprints on restores Footprint-badge controls, feeds, counters and notifications from that moment. Visits, Visitors and photo likes are unchanged.

likes.title: Photo likes
likes.summary: When it is off, photos cannot be liked and the like counter disappears; the Visitors list is always available.
likes.consequenceOff: Turning Photo likes off hides every photo-like control and counter, the Photo-likes feed, and like bell rows and push navigation. Existing likes remain stored; Visitors stays available.
likes.consequenceOn: Turning Photo likes on restores photo-like controls, counters, the Photo-likes feed and notifications from that moment. Visitors remains available in either state.
